author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes: 4.6.1 fixes two issues found after 4.5's stale-evidence flagging shipped: the advanced diagnostics tables didn't scroll properly on mobile (columns wrapped letter-by-letter instead of overflowing), and the default 'ignore non-IP evidence after N hours' threshold (12h) was too short for how Hubitat mobile presence actually behaves - it only reports on arrive/depart transitions, so a normal weekend at home with no transitions could get incorrectly flagged as stale even though the reading was accurate. Default raised to 48 hours; existing installs need to update the saved value manually since defaults don't retroactively apply.
